title: Ontology-supported AI Model and Dataset Management
abstract: arXiv:2608.21224v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recently, there has been a great deal of research into improving AI methods and their application. The main focus is on tracking progress, enabling transparent comparisons, and fostering a more profound understanding of AI. In that process, different organizations generate and use plenty of assets that need to be tracked, traced and managed. Moreover, it is important to discover assets relevant for the task at hand. This paper presents research aiming to contribute to answering the question of what is required to exchange and manage AI models and related assets effectively without semantic gaps in an industrial context. We introduce a platform for AI model exchange, which facilitates the usage, exchange, and analysis of AI models and datasets. translated_title: 支持本体的AI模型与数据集管理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21224v1 公告类型：新 摘要：近年来，关于改进AI方法及其应用的研究大量涌现。主要焦点在于追踪进展、实现透明比较，并促进对AI的更深入理解。在此过程中，不同组织生成并使用大量需要跟踪、追溯和管理的资产。此外，发现与当前任务相关的资产至关重要。本文提出研究，旨在回答在工业背景下，如何有效交换和管理AI模型及相关资产而避免语义鸿沟的问题。我们引入了一个AI模型交换平台，该平台促进AI模型和数据集的使用、交换和分析。该平台整合了一个本体，能够促进对这些任务所需内容的更深入共同理解，并帮助解决上述问题。最后，我们阐述了该平台的使用。
tldr: 本文提出一个支持本体的AI模型交换平台，通过本体论促进AI模型和数据集的有效管理、交换与分析，以解决工业环境中的语义鸿沟问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an ontology-supported AI model exchange platform that facilitates effective management, exchange, and analysis of AI models and datasets, addressing semantic gaps in industrial contexts.
